prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: picosoc-uart-div
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 8c4f2a706bdbbc3e
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback with divider 64 sent 0xa5 but recv_buf_data returned 0xe0 causing TRAP: uart data mismatch got 0xe0 want 0xa5 and tohost FAIL 0xdead. CONE_SLICE picosoc/picosoc.v:120-121 and picosoc/simpleuart.v:20 confirm divider path, agreeing with trace divider 64. Root cause in excerpt at lines 90 and 97: states 10/default compare recv_divcnt > (cfg_divider >> 4) instead of > cfg_divider, sampling each bit 16x too fast and corrupting recv_pattern into recv_buf_data.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 8c4f2a706bdbbc3e in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
